data.body: **[P2] Retain the disabled offloader for escaped inline envelopes.** `PayloadCodec` records only active offloaders. If an operation explicitly disables offloading and its custom SerDes returns reserved-marker text, the codec stores an inline escape envelope, but this fallback selects the global offloader during result inspection. A transforming custom global offloader then loads data it did not produce, corrupting or failing `getStepResult()`. Record the disabled sentinel for that entity (or otherwise retain the selected operation policy), and test a disabled operation returning marker-prefixed data with a custom global offloader.
